name: americas-news-digest
description: North and South America news with comprehensive sources and parallel fetching

steps.name: fetch-usa-canada
steps.prompt:
Fetch North American news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL - make all requests simultaneously.

🇺🇸 USA Sources:
- Associated Press: https://feeds.ap.org/apnews/top25 (primary)
- NPR News: https://feeds.npr.org/1001/rss.xml
- Reuters US: https://feeds.reuters.com/reuters/us
- CNN Top Stories: https://rss.cnn.com/rss/edition.rss

🇨🇦 Canada Sources:
- CBC Top Stories: https://www.cbc.ca/cmlink/rss-topstories (primary)
- Global News Canada: https://globalnews.ca/feed/
- Toronto Star: https://www.thestar.com/rss.xml
- Globe and Mail (check feed)

🇲🇽 Mexico:
- Mexico News Daily: https://mexiconewsdaily.com/feed/
- El Universal: https://www.eluniversal.com.mx/rss.xml

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Start ALL feed requests simultaneously (parallel)
2. If any feed takes >15 seconds, skip it
3. Don't retry failed feeds
4. Process all successful responses together

For each working source, extract:
- Top 5 recent international/national stories
- Headline
- 1-2 sentence summary
- Category (politics/business/tech/sports/culture)
- Source name

Return structured list grouped by country (USA, Canada, Mexico).

steps.name: fetch-central-south-america
steps.prompt:
Fetch Central and South American news. Fetch ALL feeds in PARALLEL.

🇧🇷 Brazil Sources:
- The Rio Times: https://riotimesonline.com/feed/ (English)
- BBC Brazil (via BBC feeds)

🇦🇷 Argentina:
- Buenos Aires Times: https://www.batimes.com.ar/feed (English)

🇨🇴 Colombia:
- Colombia Reports: https://colombiareports.com/feed/ (English)

🇨🇱 Chile:
- Santiago Times (if available)

🇵🇪 Peru:
- Peru Reports (if available)

🇻🇪 Venezuela:
- Caracas Chronicles (if available)

Fetch ALL feeds simultaneously. Skip any >15s or failing.

Note: Many sources may be in Spanish/Portuguese - extract what you can in English.

Extract top 3-5 stories per country with headline and summary.

Return structured list noting language challenges if any.

steps.name: format-americas-digest
steps.prompt:
Create a comprehensive Americas News Digest.

NORTH AMERICA:
{{north_america}}

CENTRAL & SOUTH AMERICA:
{{latin_america}}

FORMAT:
```
🌎 **Americas News Digest — {date}**

**🇺🇸 United States**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source: AP/NPR/Reuters)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇨🇦 Canada**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source: CBC/Global)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇲🇽 Mexico**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source: Mexico News Daily)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Source)*

**🇧🇷 Brazil, 🇦🇷 Argentina, 🇨🇴 Colombia**
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*
• [Headline] — Summary *(Country flag + Source)*

**📊 Americas Brief**
Top themes across the continent:
• [Theme 1]
• [Theme 2]

_Covering North, Central & South America — OpenFang Regional News_
```

Select the most significant stories from each country. Keep under 2000 characters. Include country flags for context.
